name: Slack
description: A cloud-based team communication and collaboration platform offering messaging, file sharing, and extensive API integrations.

evidence.claim: Slack uses OAuth 2.0 to provide an installation flow that allows apps to be added to any workspace.
Slack APIs provide access to read, write, and update many types of data in Slack.
There is an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for the Slack API.
Slack offers a Developer Program with sandboxes for testing features.

notes: Slack provides a comprehensive API ecosystem including Web API, Events API, and Socket Mode. It supports bot, user, and app-level tokens with granular scopes.
